item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 26/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a ridge of high pressure over southeastern China, it will be brighter and hot over Guangdong today and tomorrow. The broad area of low pressure now to the east of the Philippines will enter the central part of the South China Sea midweek this week. Whether it will develop into a tropical cyclone remains uncertain. The low pressure system will then have a higher chance to move towards Hainan Island and its adjacent waters. Under the combined effect of the low pressure system and the ridge of high pressure, it will be windy with showers and squally thunderstorms over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. There will be swells. With the low pressure system departing, showers will ease off over Guangdong early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kajiki will move into the inland areas of Indo-China and dissipate gradually today.
